title: Close Core harness streamable-HTTP MCP sessions
goal: Give the Core harness MCP client an idempotent explicit close and best-effort drop cleanup so streamable-HTTP sessions are released with DELETE /mcp.

results.change: Transport has a default close hook; McpClient exposes idempotent close and best-effort drop cleanup; HttpSocketTransport releases its session with DELETE /mcp, carrying session, protocol and bearer headers, accepting 2xx and 405; closed clients reject later initialization and requests
results.acceptance: cargo test --offline --locked -p susi-harness --lib mcp: 20 passed, 0 failed
results.boundary: Core harness MCP session lifecycle only; no dependency, Commercial, Minijinja, release, or credential changes
